purpose: Versioned source contract for a frozen intraday replay tape consumed by the P12 paper bound-session open. A buy confirm uses only the open the source DECLARES by name; it never infers an open from a minute label, the earliest visible tick or the first-minute bar.

time_label.note: minute_start: point.time is the minute the bar OPENS (Tencent m1), visible when that minute ends (label+1min). minute_end: point.time is the minute the bar CLOSES, visible at the label.

visible_at.note: label_end pairs with minute_start (visible at label+1min); label_time pairs with minute_end (visible at the label).

open_field.note: When set, a point row on the bound day declares the session open via this named field.

opens.note: Source-declared named opens; visible at the replay-visible moment of the named label.

rules: The bound open is a NAMED fact the source declares via open_field rows or contract.opens entries, on the same security and bound day, already visible at the confirm clock.
Exactly one declared open is used; zero leaves the quote open empty (named refuse), two or more distinct declared values are refused as ambiguous.
A tape with no _contract, or a contract missing time_label/open declaration, supplies no open and the buy confirm refuses by name.
Pre-open imprints, the first-minute bar and later last-price ticks keep their own timestamps and are never the open unless the source declares them so.
